description: MainActivity.kt defines the MainActivity class for an Android app, which manages lifecycle events, UI setup using Jetpack Compose, permission requests, and interaction with a ViewModel for app state. It also handles intents related to an assistant feature and manages a foreground service.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity for the app, managing lifecycle, UI, permissions, and intent handling.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up lifecycle observers, permissions, and Compose UI.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Sets the app to foreground state when activity starts.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Sets the app to background state when activity stops.

methods.name: onNewIntent
methods.description: Handles new intents received while activity is running, including assistant launch requests.

methods.name: handleAssistantIntent
methods.description: Processes assistant-related intent and triggers ViewModel handling.
